lines.1: Commence Operation: Tame Her with Treats.
lines.2: 「I wanted to talk to you again.」
lines.3: 「Why don't we talk in the college cafeteria? We can eat while looking out at the ocean.」
lines.6: 「Come on, hear your senior out. This is a serious matter.」
lines.7: 「If you find me that unpleasant, you can slap me or whatever you want.」
lines.9: 「Even if you won't go to the cafeteria, how about some juice?」
lines.10: I hold out a classic orange juice.
lines.11: 「I am not in the mood for orange right now.」
lines.12: 「What are you in the mood for?」
lines.14: 「Sure. We all have days like that.」
lines.16: I brought everything the cafeteria sells.
lines.17: When I commit to something, I do it right. Money is no object.
lines.18: I pull the juice from my bag and offer it to her.
lines.19: 「I have no reason to let you buy me anything.」
lines.20: 「Consider it an apology for taking up your time. Don't overthink it. Just drink.」
lines.21: 「If you insist, I will accept for the sake of my senpai's dignity.」
lines.22: She looks reluctant, but she takes it.
lines.23: First things first: I need to make a good impression on her.
lines.27: 「Are you used to this school yet?」
